content:
#4 I believe that I have fixed the bug now. Was quite a subtle one! It will only have affected pages with a quite complex table of contents; if you see a page which looks problematic, let me know, or re-save it.

There is also a problem with one of the tables at geometric quantization. I will look into it.
subject: Error in "geometric quantization"

content:
#5 Have now fixed the including of the table geometric quantization extensions - table. There was a bug here (again, a bit of a subtle one!) coming from the fact that this table immediately follows mathematics; Maruku/Itex2MML parses this in such a way that there is no blank line between the end of the mathematics and the beginning of the table, and this means that, whilst the page itself displays fine, when including it in another page, Maruku could not parse the table correctly. This is related to the problem that Maruku’s rendering of tables is not idempotent, as I mentioned once before. I have fixed it simply by adding back the space; I had this fix in an earlier version of the new renderer, but had removed it because I thought it was not necessary (which it is not in most cases, but a table immediately following mathematics was a corner case I had not thought to check).

Anyhow, geometric quantization should now be displaying fine, hopefully.
subject: Error in "geometric quantization"

content: #7 It works for me! Thanks a lot!
